# source independence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sourceIndependence`](gmeow-sourceIndependence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sourceIndependence>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

The independence status of the source referenced by a citation — independent or self/issuer originated. Non-functional: competing assessments by different standpoints coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
